title: LastRequestStats
description: GET /v1/last-request-stats[?model=<id>] — throughput and token/timing stats of the LAST request this proxy served for a model. Auth: inference API key (Bearer). The body is a single flat object describing that one request, with no nesting. The 'model' parameter is optional ('model_id' is an alias) and filters to one model; when omitted the most recent request across every model is returned. Thinking suffixes (e.g. 'model(high)') are stripped before lookup, and either the upstream model name or the client-requested alias resolves a model. There are no aggregation parameters by design: this endpoint reports one request, which is what a polling client UI needs. TPS is output tokens per second of GENERATION time, so time to first token is excluded whenever the upstream reported one (see 'generation_ms'). There is no in-body empty state: when nothing has matched yet — a model that has not run, or an idle session — the endpoint answers 404 with {"error": string} (see $defs/error). Clients therefore have exactly two states: 200 with this object, or 404. Data is in-process history of completed requests: failed, non-generating and zero-token requests are never recorded, and a late-arriving older record for the same model never displaces a newer one. Status codes: 200 (this schema), 401 bad key, 404 no matching request. Suitable for polling on an interval (e.g. 30s) while a client UI is visible; the read path performs no upstream calls. The route was /v1/last-request-tps in v8.0.901 and was renamed to /v1/last-request-stats in v8.0.902; the body and every field are identical, and the old path is not served. Compatibility: additive-only under /v1 — new optional fields may appear, existing fields never change type or meaning; clients MUST ignore unknown properties and tolerate absent optional fields. Retention is one sample per model in memory, so after a restart, or for a model that has not run since, the endpoint answers 404 again.

model.description: Upstream model that served the request.

alias.description: Client-requested model name, when the request used an alias.

provider.description: Upstream provider key that served the request.

ttft_ms.description: Time to first token in milliseconds; 0 when the upstream reported none.

generation_ms.description: Time spent producing tokens: duration_ms minus ttft_ms when both are known, otherwise the full duration.

output_tokens.description: Completion token count; the numerator of tps.

tps.description: output_tokens per second of generation_ms; 0 when there is no generation time or no output.

stream.description: Whether the request was executed in streaming mode.
